newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close unchanged despite Tele Danmark.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close unchanged despite Tele Danmark.

text.p: Danish share prices closed unchanged on Monday despite solid falls for key blue chip Tele Danmark on a profit warning, with dealers seeing levels holding provided nothing untoward happened on Wall Street
"It is impressive that the index managed to close unchanged in defiance of the Tele Danmark tumble. It was Novo Nordisk and Moeller rises which kept the index from falling." one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed unchanged at 153.46, while the KFX June future rose 0.35 point to 152.55 with 180 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Tele Danmark shed 14 crowns to end the day at 326 in 468,000 share turnover after issuing a statement warning of possible annual losses of up to 1.9 billion crowns due to impending new market deregulation laws.
Novo was the next most traded paper, closing two crowns up at 659, while Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg put on 2,000 and 6,500 crowns respectively to close at 201,000 and 291,500.
Overall turnover for the day was 946 million crowns.
